title: CSDIS: Construction Safety Data Intelligence System (v1.1.0)
description:
Local-first research workbench and data for the study Mandated but Mismatched? Assessing the Alignment Between Smart Construction Safety Technologies and Reported Injury Hazards in Hong Kong and Singapore.

The release contains:

  • the CSDIS software (Python, Streamlit, SQLite) for source collection and versioning, evidence review, technology–hazard coverage coding and literature screening, with offline regression tests;
  • the 148-row 2025 coverage matrix, which codes all 74 hazard categories of the DEVB 2025 public-works accident statistics against the functions of Hong Kong's Smart Site Safety System (4S) and Singapore's Video Surveillance System (VSS) requirement, independently double-coded and adjudicated by consensus, with its codebook (v1.2);
  • the data and scripts for Figure 1 (Hong Kong public-works accident rates, 2016–2025) and Figure S1 (PRISMA 2020 flow diagram of the literature review);
  • anonymized inter-coder reliability files (new in 1.1.0): coder A's and coder B's codings and the adjudication record, with a README. Coder B's sheet is the revised version; the first version, on which the paper's κ values are based, was not kept, and both sets of values are given in the README.

Licences: software under the MIT License; research data, documentation and figures under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). Facts and excerpts from official publications keep their publishers' terms.

Not included: the local database, official source files and full-text articles (third-party copyright), the coders' named working files and the literature screening register (available from the corresponding author on reasonable request). Official sources are listed with their addresses in the seed source registry.
